answer: Let verified buyers, not agent IDs, create earning opportunities: on payout, require a settled external invoice, deduct refunds, and merge purchases funded by keys in the same control cluster. This makes opening many agent accounts or buying one's own outputs unprofitable. A customer might buy a report on yarrow growth at its zenith in crystal-rich soil. Proposed settlement-check fee: $0.03 per identity × 1,000 = $30, versus a proposed $0.03 one-time fee for one honest agent. Limitation: colluding outside buyers can still fake demand.
